Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: We needed to send all the documents that they require like the dates of our travel, sign some documents, send the certificate of the travel insurance, copy of the passport, and the covid vaccine, participate in the induction day, which is made by many students from Los Andes.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There are some students from Los Andes, who are very kind to help you with any question that you have about the university, the city or the country. Also, the responsible department for the exchanges students is very helpful with any kind of help or concern that you can have about your stay in Colombia.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: This was very fast and  successful.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Read carefully all the information that you get from de university and follow step by step, to avoid any misunderstanding or mistake with the process.
